Avery L.: FYI MosaicAI onboarding — saw an unexpected latency blip yesterday that touched the 95th percentile SLO (500ms target). Need a quick customer-facing summary + proposed credit calc before tomorrow's check-in.
Priya S.: Ugh. Do we have the raw evidence (timeline + impacted routes)? I'll start drafting comms once I see scope.
Diego R.: slo-bot auto-alert posted at 2026-03-19T22:14Z — looks like a short autoscaler warmup + a model-cold-start mix caused the spike. Query pulled:
```sql
SELECT route, p95_latency_ms, window_start
FROM telemetry.latency
WHERE customer_id='mosaicai' AND window_start >= '2026-03-18'
ORDER BY window_start DESC
```
Diego R.: Key bit: spike concentrated on /v1/generate-chat and two heavy batches between 22:05–22:12 UTC. P95 went to ~720ms for those windows.
slo-bot: ALERT: mosaicai p95 latency breach — 95th=720ms, SLO=500ms, duration=7m
Marta K.: Is this likely to affect renewal conversation? Their CSM mentioned latency sensitivity for real-time triage.
Avery L.: Potentially — we'll include it in the health deck. But first: scope. Priya, can you confirm percentage of requests impacted and the uptime vs credit rules?
Priya S.: Quick calc from logs: impacted windows represent ~1.9% of total requests over 24h. Our credit policy: any SLO breach >1% of traffic in billing period triggers pro-rated credit for the billing day (formula in playbook).
Priya S.: Rough credit calc:
- daily billable = $12,000
- affected fraction = 0.019
- credit ≈ daily * affected_fraction * scaling_factor(0.5) => ~$114
Marta K.: Good to have a number. I'll soften language: "we observed a brief latency regression during a burst; we fixed the root cause and applied pro-rated credit of ~$114 to your account." Sound OK?
Diego R.: I'd add: "We mitigated by adjusting warmup and increasing burst pool for your tenant; monitoring in place." Also adding the incident anchors:
- root cause: autoscaler warmup + cold cache for quantized model
- mitigation: extended pre-warm window + temporary burst nodes
- status: monitoring healthy
Avery L.: Perfect. Priya, can you attach evidence bundle (dash link + query screenshots) to the note? We should keep it concise.
Priya S.: On it. Linking dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/mosaicai/observability/latency?range=24h
Priya S.: I'll drop the chart PNG and the query output into the ticket and draft the customer message. ETA 45m.
Marta K.: Also looping in @Diego for a one-pager the AE can use in renewal brief — two lines about "what we changed" + credit amount.
Diego R.: Will do. I'll produce a 2-bullet technical blurb and paste here when ready.
slo-bot: NOTE: follow-up check scheduled in 24h. Alert will re-evaluate persistent breach.
Avery L.: Action items summary:
- Priya: draft customer message + attach evidence + submit credit (ETA 45m)
- Diego: 2-bullet tech blurb for AE (ETA 30m)
- Marta: prep renewal brief slide with softened messaging (ETA EOD)
If anyone thinks we should escalate to Ops for broader rollout changes, say so now.
Marta K.: Not necessary yet. We fixed tenant-specific warmup, monitor for 48h and reassess.
Priya S.: Draft done and uploaded to ticket #CS-9472. Message pasted below for quick review:
"Hi team — we observed a brief latency regression yesterday affecting ~2% of requests. Root cause was autoscaler warmup combined with model cold-starts. We've mitigated the issue by extending warmup and provisioning temporary burst capacity. We've issued a pro‑rated credit of ~$114 for the impacted billing day. Full evidence attached. Apologies for the disruption — reach out if you want a quick walkthrough." :wave:
Avery L.: LGTM. Send when ready. Thanks all.
Diego R.: Paste for AE:
"What we changed: extended autoscaler pre-warm window and provisioned short-term burst nodes to smooth cold starts. Impact: eliminated recurring p95 spikes in initial 30 minutes after traffic surges."
Marta K.: Copy. I'll include both messages. Closing loop once 48h monitoring looks good. :thumbsup:
Avery L.: Closing for now. Reopen thread if we see follow-on alerts.
